summary: End-to-end testing of NeonKeys multi-vendor digital goods marketplace. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases passing covering auth, catalog, deposits with duplicate TXID rejection, admin deposit approval, insufficient balance, purchase & delivery, concurrency (no overselling, no duplicate keys, non-negative balance), commissions (global + per-vendor override), vendor product + keys (dedupe) + admin approval with price override, withdrawal pay/reject-refund, suspend-blocks-login, admin credit/debit, admin stats, audit log and address management. Frontend: buyer/vendor/admin login flows, wrong-password error, vendor register goes directly to vendor dashboard showing pending/awaiting approval, marketplace loads 18 products, admin panel renders all 7 tabs (deposits, withdrawals, vendors, listings, users, settings/commission, audit log), wallet page shows embedded Add Funds form + deposit history + balance history, product detail Buy button present, mobile 390px shows functional bottom-nav.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <option> (caused by dev tooling injecting data-source spans inside <option> text). Not functionally broken but logs a console warning on every render.

critical_code_review_comments: Seed addresses are placeholders ('REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_<COIN>_ADDRESS'); tests had to seed a real-looking BTC address via admin settings before deposit flow could run. Document this expectation to prod operators or short-circuit the create_deposit endpoint earlier with a clearer message.

server.py:276 unset of order_id/buyer_id uses find_one_and_update with mixed $set+$unset in one update doc - works but $set and $unset must be two separate top-level operators (they are, OK). Verified compensation on rare race.

admin_vendors with status='all' still filters role='vendor' but admin_vendors('pending') default fine; register endpoint allows role='buyer' or 'vendor' but 'admin' creation blocked by Literal - correct.
login_attempts has no TTL index; locked_until check uses iso string comparison which works as long as same timezone format - OK but TTL would clean up stale records.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all surveyed flows functional, 1 console hydration warning on select

seed_data_creation: Tests seeded a BTC deposit address 'bc1qtestdepositaddress' via /api/admin/settings so deposit flow can execute (placeholder address blocks creation by design). Also created many TEST_ prefixed buyers/vendors/products.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (22 cases, run with pytest). Crypto addresses in settings now include a test BTC value - resetting may be needed before user demo. UI data-testids follow pattern: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, register-*, register-role-vendor, buy-now-btn, admin-tab-<section>, deposit-coin-select, bottom-nav, product-card-<id>. There is a React hydration warning on the AddFunds <select><option> due to dev tooling injecting <span> children into <option> elements - this appears to be caused by the x-source metadata attributes in the build, not application code; investigate build tooling if removing is a priority.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. The one console warning (<span> inside <option>) traces to dev-time source-map tooling adding meta spans into option elements - cosmetic only.
